description: Request quotes. Every request needs the confirmation from the status: show its summary, get the customer's explicit yes, then pass its token and their exact reply. Nothing is requested unless requested comes back true; reason says why not, and status is the intent after the call. On stale_confirmation the facts changed: show the new confirmation and ask again.

token.description: The status confirmation's token; a changed fact makes it stale.

idempotencyKey.description: Unique key for safely retrying this customer action

intentId.description: The shopping intent id returned by an earlier shopping tool.
